before_snapshot.comment: DRY ZINC-CHLORIDE MANUFACTURE REFERENCE,2026-10-20. User selected dry salt supply with aqueous supply tested separately. Retain source 0.6538kgZn+0.72916kgPURE-equivalentHCl per1.363kg nominal ZnCl2. Zn+2HCl->ZnCl2+H2 generates0.02016kgH2 per source batch. The existing0.02kgHydrogen-to-air row already represents this rounded source byproduct; retain it exactly and do not add another H2flow. Exact common-atomic-mass salt is1.3628kg; inherited1.363kg is source rounding (0.0147%),not a large sizing error. Do not silently change metal feeds or the rounded product reference. The30wt% acid supplier carries 1.70137333333333kg water in this batch; its purchase already includes this carrier,so do not buy it again. Dry reference removes it as Water to air,in cubic meters at1000kg/m3. Nominal unrecovered reactionH2 goes to air with no sale,energy or recycling credit; actual gas capture/acid fumes/impurity purification are unknown. UN ECAFE1965 Asian Industrial Development NewsNo1,p97 documents Zn/HCl dissolution,H2,filtration and evaporation/fusion around300C. https://repository.unescap.org/items/f7aa8333-be2e-4a42-97d5-63438c4e11eb/full (indexed process text inspected; fullPDF inaccessible in this session). Commercial solid grades exist,for example98-100.5%assay https://anmolchem.in/Zinc-Chloride-USP.php ; this is availability evidence,not plant-LCI or measured yield. Original study Zhang2025 DOI10.1039/D4EB00027G doesnot specify supplied phase. Selected dry reference requires explicit utilities rather than treating reagent purchases as complete manufacture. Water-only gross load uses25->100C,cp4.18kJ/kgK andlatent2255kJ/kg (NIST https://www.nist.gov/document/chapter-9pdf),giving 4.36997740666667MJ/batch. Add an EXPLICIT1MJ/kg salt finishing/dehydration allowance,not measured ZnCl2heat capacity or fusion enthalpy. Divide useful process load by selected0.70equipment heat-transfer utilization. Native furnace already models fuel conversion; do not add/divide by a second combustion efficiency. This gives 8.18996772380952MJ purchased industrial-gas furnace heat per source batch. It is an engineering reference,not measured commercial energy. Dissolution exotherm is assumed unrecovered in a cooled initial operation; test recovered heat separately,without a fictitious energy coproduct. No recovered condensate credit. Auxiliary0.10kWh/kg salt covers assumed agitation,pumping,filtration and controls; it is not a measured equipment BOM. Test finishing0.3-3MJ/kg,transfer0.4-0.9,aux0.02-0.3 kWh/kg and50%water-heat recovery coherently. Actual boiling elevation/vacuum,hydration/purity,plant losses,utilities/emissions and gas management remain unqualified. No invented trace-metal assay or primary/secondary split. Source Zn/acid/transport/output, HFB salt doses and downstream water,capacity,hardware,chemical replacements and lifetime denominators are unchanged. Aqueous counterfactual must retain carrier in product,subtract it from make-up water and scale delivery transport; do not apply dry evaporation to that counterfactual. Existing supplemental workbook only; no runtime,YAML or method changes.
before_snapshot.source: Zhang, S., Ramanujam, A. S., Arvidsson, R., Michieletto, A., & Schubert, U. S. (2025). Prospective life cycle assessment of organic redox flow batteries. EES Batteries. doi: https://doi.org/10.1039/D4EB00027G
